integrity: Proof is self-contained modulo standard finite-field facts. Program checks finite field degrees and exhaustive length-eight orderings; this is not external or independent validation. Priority has residual uncertainty.
scientific_limitations: Only one binary bit-flip burst and extended Hamming codes; existence of optimal orderings is proved, classification of all orderings is not attempted; no higher-alphabet or multiple-burst implication.
title: Optimal three-position burst covering for extended binary Hamming codes
